definitions.explanation: Literally one word, but often means a brief comment or remark.

examples.japanese: {一言|ひとこと}⟦お{願|ねが}いします→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.notes: Common request at events or gatherings

examples.japanese: {一言|ひとこと}⟦{言|い}わせてください→言う：00515_iu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一言|ひとこと}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{話|はな}さなかった→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: He didn't say a single word.

examples.japanese: {一言|ひとこと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: In a word, it was a failure.
examples.notes: {一言|ひとこと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧ = in a word, to put it briefly

examples.japanese: {一言|ひとこと}⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嫌|きら}われ→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧⟦やすい→やすい：18367_yasui⟧。
examples.english: People who always have one word too many tend to be disliked.
examples.notes: {一言|ひとこと}⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ = saying one word too many

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一言|ひとこと}、⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: In closing, I would like to say a few words of thanks.

notes:
Often used to request or offer a brief comment.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一言|ひとこと}⟦お{願|ねが}いします→願う：02387_negau⟧ (Please say a few words)
- {一言|ひとこと}⟦{言|い}わせてください→言う：00515_iu⟧ (Let me say something)
- {一言|ひとこと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧ (in a word, to put it briefly)
- {一言|ひとこと}⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (one word too many; talks too much)
- {一言|ひとこと}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}わない→言う：00515_iu⟧ (not say a word)

ALTERNATIVE READING:
- いちごん - more formal, literary reading
- ひとこと - everyday usage

COUNTER NOTE:
- Despite meaning "one word," {一言|ひとこと} often refers to a brief statement, not literally a single word.
